name: outputty
description: A scaffold for developing with Claude Code, copied into the repo by /outputty:init and owned there: /plan grills, spikes every level, takes your pick and files one ticket; /tickets picks the next; /build takes it to one PR under a /goal you type, docs last, or to one stacked PR per layer when you label the ticket stack. The tracker skill is the repo's; GitHub Issues ships as the implementation.

plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: One command, /outputty:init, that copies the scaffold into a repo: the skills plan, prototype, tickets, build, retro, tracker, herdr, documentation, data-engineering, frontend and typescript-node, the output style, the outputty entries merged into CLAUDE.md, path-scoped rules, a ticket template, a PR template, an expert-skill template, a README template, and settings. The repo edits its copy; a re-run reports drift per file. A build runs under /goal; review is /code-review.
